use default
use Raster.IMAGE
use System.Math

use Point = (x: double, y: double)
use Curve = (p0: Point, p1: Point, p2: Point, from: double, to: double)
use Hit = (t: double, s: double, at: Point)

let tolerance = 1.0e-9

pt(x: double, y: double) -> Point => (x = x, y = y)

middle(a: Point, b: Point) -> Point =>
    pt((a.x + b.x) / 2.0D, (a.y + b.y) / 2.0D)

point_at(c: Curve, t: double) -> Point =>
    let u = 1.0D - t in
    pt(
        u * u * c.p0.x + 2.0D * u * t * c.p1.x + t * t * c.p2.x,
        u * u * c.p0.y + 2.0D * u * t * c.p1.y + t * t * c.p2.y)

halves(c: Curve) -> (Curve, Curve) =>
    let left = middle(c.p0, c.p1), right = middle(c.p1, c.p2) in
    let split = middle(left, right), t = (c.from + c.to) / 2.0D in
    ((c.p0, left, split, c.from, t), (split, right, c.p2, t, c.to))

low(a: double, b: double, c: double) -> double =>
    Math.min(a, Math.min(b, c))

high(a: double, b: double, c: double) -> double =>
    Math.max(a, Math.max(b, c))

box(c: Curve) -> (low: Point, high: Point) =>
    (
        low = pt(
            low(c.p0.x, c.p1.x, c.p2.x), low(c.p0.y, c.p1.y, c.p2.y)),
        high = pt(
            high(c.p0.x, c.p1.x, c.p2.x), high(c.p0.y, c.p1.y, c.p2.y)))

overlap(a: Curve, b: Curve) -> bool =>
    let p = box(a), q = box(b) in
    p.low.x <= q.high.x /\ q.low.x <= p.high.x /\
    p.low.y <= q.high.y /\ q.low.y <= p.high.y

size(c: Curve) -> double =>
    let b = box(c) in Math.max(b.high.x - b.low.x, b.high.y - b.low.y)

near(a: double, b: double) -> bool => Math.abs(a - b) < 1.0e-6

intersect(a: Curve, b: Curve, hits: LIST[Hit]) is
    if !overlap(a, b) then
        return
    fi

    if size(a) < tolerance /\ size(b) < tolerance then
        let t = (a.from + a.to) / 2.0D
        let s = (b.from + b.to) / 2.0D

        if !(hits |> any(h => near(h.t, t) /\ near(h.s, s))) then
            hits.add((t, s, middle(a.p0, a.p2)))
        fi

        return
    fi

    let (a0, a1) = halves(a)
    let (b0, b1) = halves(b)

    for x in [a0, a1] do
        for y in [b0, b1] do
            intersect(x, y, hits)
        od
    od
si

whole(p0: Point, p1: Point, p2: Point) -> Curve => (p0, p1, p2, 0.0D, 1.0D)

let first = whole(pt(-1.0D, 0.0D), pt(0.0D, 10.0D), pt(1.0D, 0.0D))
let second = whole(pt(2.0D, 1.0D), pt(-8.0D, 2.0D), pt(2.0D, 3.0D))

let hits = LIST[Hit]()

intersect(first, second, hits)

write_line("       t           s                  x            y")

for h in hits |> sort((a, b) => a.t <> b.t) do
    let at = "({h.at.x,11:F8}, {h.at.y,11:F8})"

    write_line("{h.t,10:F8}  {h.s,10:F8}     {at}")
od

let image = IMAGE(380, 350)

image.view(-3.5D, -0.8D, 3.5D, 5.6D)
image.clear(252ub, 250ub, 245ub)
image.stroke(2.0D)

trace(curve: Curve) -> List[Point] =>
    (0::100)
        |> map(i => point_at(curve, cast double(i) / 100.0D))
        |> collect_list()

image.colour(40ub, 90ub, 170ub)
image.line(trace(first))

image.colour(190ub, 70ub, 40ub)
image.line(trace(second))

image.colour(20ub, 20ub, 20ub)

for h in hits do
    image.ring(h.at.x, h.at.y, 5.0D)
od

image.write("intersections.png")

image.show("intersections.png")
